Long Island homes we’ve filmed

What film does first

Three things you notice within a day

The heat, the glare and the fading are what bring most homeowners to us. Film addresses all three from the inside of the glass, with no construction and no lost daylight.

Year-round comfort

Even out hot and cold spots so the rooms you avoid in summer become the ones you actually want to use.

Reduced glare

Cut harsh glare on TVs, laptops and monitors so you can work and relax without fighting the afternoon sun.

UV protection

Select LLumar® residential solar-control films block more than 99% of the UV rays that contribute to fading. UV is one contributor — film reduces exposure rather than preventing fading entirely.

How it works

Three steps, no surprises

  1. 1

    Request a free quote

    Send the short form, or call or text. We’ll ask a few questions about the rooms and the glass.

  2. 2

    We recommend the right film

    A free consultation at your home: we check the glass, the orientation and the look you want, and propose a film with a written quote.

  3. 3

    Professional installation

    Installed cleanly in an occupied home, with the manufacturer’s limited warranty available on qualifying products.

Room by room

Where window film makes the biggest difference

Every home has a few problem windows. These are the spaces homeowners ask us about most.

  • Living rooms — tame glare on the TV and keep the space comfortable all afternoon
  • Bathrooms — frosted privacy film that still lets daylight through
  • Bedrooms — cut heat and morning glare for better sleep
  • Sliding & patio doors — reduce hot spots and fading near large glass
  • Sunrooms & additions — make all-glass spaces usable in peak summer sun

Beyond comfort

Three more reasons homeowners choose film

Daytime privacy

Reflective and frosted films keep passersby from seeing in during the day while you keep your view and natural light.

Lower energy bills

By rejecting solar heat gain, film eases the load on your AC in summer — and Low-E options help hold heat in winter.

Added safety

Security films help hold shattered glass together on impact — protection against storms, accidents and break-ins.
